comments.body:
Hi Andrew Woods

 

The PR https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-docker/pull/1 resolves the first part of the ticket: "Create a Dockerfile". Would be great if you or Danny Bernstein could take a look and let me know if the options to configure fcrepo-webapp are correct and sufficient.
Thomas Bernhart: I merged the PR - would you mind updating the README to include the instructions for buidling and running that you gave in the PR description?

Building this container seems to fail for me:
```
Step 1/6 : FROM tomcat:9-jdk11-openjdk
---> d03312117bb0
Step 2/6 : ENV TOMCAT_USERS_FILE=$CATALINA_HOME/conf/tomcat-users.xml FEDORA_ADMIN_PASSWORD=fedoraAdmin FCREPO_OCFL_STAGING_DIR=/var/lib/fcrepo/staging FCREPO_OCFL_STORAGE_ROOT_DIR=/var/lib/fcrepo/ocfl FCREPO_OCFL_WORK_DIR=/var/lib/fcrepo/work FCREPO_ACTIVEMQ_DIRECTORY=/var/lib/fcrepo/activemq FCREPO_AUDIT_CONTAINER=/audit
---> Using cache
---> dd50dc5aedd3
Step 3/6 : COPY tomcat/conf/* $CATALINA_HOME/conf/
---> Using cache
---> 533bca21c5f9
Step 4/6 : COPY tomcat/bin/* $CATALINA_HOME/bin/setenv.sh
---> Using cache
---> e0f2f3fc472f
Step 5/6 : COPY fcrepo-webapp.war /tmp/fcrepo-webapp.war
COPY failed: stat /var/lib/docker/tmp/docker-builder628469830/fcrepo-webapp.war: no such file or directory
```

Hi Danny Bernstein

I created a second PR to finish the work on fcrepo-docker: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-docker/pull/2

I also added ci@fedora.info as an e-mail address to the docker hub user fcrepoci. Could you please use it, to set a new password and then remove my private E-Mail from that account? You can change e-mail addresses under Account Settings, once your logged in: https://hub.docker.com/settings/general

 

Once this is done, you can

  • enable the travis pipeline for fcrepo-docker
  • add the secrets DOCKER_USERNAME and DOCKER_PASSWORD to the travis build pipeline
